# Relay

> **BETA** — APIs and behavior may change.

Publishing API for AI agents. Publish HTML templates with `{{placeholder}}` syntax, attach JSON data, and the server renders them together at view time. Update the data anytime — same URL, fresh output.

## Stack
- Next.js 16 App Router, Drizzle ORM, Neon Postgres
- Better Auth (Google OAuth only) + `@better-auth/api-key` plugin
- CLI: `relay` (`@androff/relay-cli`)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol): `/api/mcp` (header auth) or `/api/mcp/{token}` (URL auth)

## Key files
- `web/lib/auth.ts` — Better Auth config
- `web/lib/auth-client.ts` — auth client
- `web/db/schema.ts` — Drizzle schema
- `web/app/api/mcp/lib.ts` — shared MCP server logic
- `web/app/api/mcp/route.ts` — header-based MCP route (backward compat)
- `web/app/api/mcp/[token]/route.ts` — URL-based MCP proxy route
- `web/app/dashboard/components/McpSection.tsx` — MCP dashboard UI
- `web/app/dashboard/page.tsx` — dashboard (API keys, MCP, pages)
- `cli/src/index.ts` — CLI entrypoint (commander)

## Template interpolation

The core feature: publish HTML with `{{placeholder}}` syntax, values are filled from the page's JSON data at serve time. HTML-escaped by default (safe against XSS).

```html
<h1>{{title}}</h1>
<p>{{body}}</p>
<script>console.log(window.__PH_DATA)</script>
```

Update data anytime via `set_post_data` (MCP) or `relay data set` (CLI) — same URL, fresh output.

## Auth flow
1. User signs in with Google via landing page
2. Session cookie for dashboard
3. Dashboard generates API keys (prefix `post_`) or MCP tokens (prefix `mcp_`)
4. CLI uses `x-api-key` header → `auth.api.verifyApiKey()` on post routes

## MCP
- URL format: `https://posthtml.vercel.app/api/mcp/<mcp_...token>`
- Generate from dashboard sidebar → MCP Server → Generate URL
- No `x-api-key` header needed — auth is in the URL path
- Old `/api/mcp` with `x-api-key` header still works
- Available tools: `list_posts`, `get_post`, `publish_page`, `update_page`, `delete_post`,
  `get_post_data`, `set_post_data`

## API auth
- Dashboard routes: session cookie
- Post/CLI routes: `x-api-key` header (verified via Better Auth `verifyApiKey`)
- MCP: `x-api-key` header (old) or URL path token (new)
- Public viewer `/p/:id`: no auth

## Installation

### CLI
```bash
npm install -g @androff/relay-cli
```

Configure your API key:
```bash
relay setup --key <your-key>
# or set env vars:
export RELAY_API_KEY=***
export POST_URL=https://posthtml.vercel.app
```

### Commands
```bash
relay publish index.html                              # publish a page
relay publish index.html --data '{"status":"draft"}'   # publish + attach JSON data
relay publish index.html --data-file meta.json         # or merge a whole JSON file
relay publish index.html --private                     # create as private (owner-only)
relay publish index.html --public                      # create as public (default)
relay update <id> file.html --private                # update + set private (preserves URL)
relay update <id> file.html --public                 # update + set public
relay list                                            # list your pages
relay delete <id>                                     # delete a page
relay update <id> file.html                          # update page content (preserves URL)
relay data get <id>                                   # read a page's JSON data
relay data set <id> --key <k> --value '<json>'        # merge one key into a page's JSON data
relay data set <id> --file data.json                  # merge a whole JSON file into a page's data
```

## Quick test
```bash
POST_URL=https://posthtml.vercel.app RELAY_API_KEY=*** relay list
```
